newsitem.title: UK: Hague 6-4 favourite as Conservative leader.
newsitem.headline: Hague 6-4 favourite as Conservative leader.

text.p: Former Welsh Secretary William Hague was installed on Tuesday as 6-4 favourite to be the next leader of Britain's Conservative Party after John Major announced he is to step down.

Bookmaker William Hill made former finance minister Kenneth Clarke the second favourite at 4-1 followed by interior minister Michael Howard and former social security secretary Peter Lilley both on 9-2.
Rightwinger John Redwood, who officially confirmed his candidature on Tuesday, was quoted as a 10-1 shot.
